sum: Solana Company operates as a listed digital asset treasury. The company enhances Solana tokens per share on the commercially viable blockchain for decentralized finance and consumer applications. It also focuses on neurological wellness. In addition, the company offers Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator, a non-implantable medical device, which delivers mild electrical stimulation to the surface of the tongue to provide treatment of gait deficit and chronic balance deficit. Solana Company is headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania.
ceo: Mr. Choon Wee  Chee (CEO, President & Chairman)
